idea: 'Can I afford X?' answers from cash on hand minus bills due before next payday (2nd and 4th Thursday), and flags any category over its cap.
Bill radar: lists bills due in the next 7 days with the amount and days left, and auto-adds a to-do for each one that's unpaid.
Usage saver: ranks bots and routines by usage, names the top one that rarely produces output, and offers a one-tap 'mark to pause' to-do (it doesn't change routines itself).
Morning brief button: three lines covering today's to-dos, bills due and spend left this week, generated from templates with no AI.
Safe self-run tasks only touch local data: check off, snooze or reorder to-dos, recompute caps, and export a CSV. Anything involving money, sending or wallets stays read-only.
